# Najik Project - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
Najik is a location tracking web app for helping elderly parents navigate the city with real-time location sharing and SOS emergency features.

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 14+ with App Router
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Supabase (database, auth, real-time)
- Firebase Cloud Messaging (push notifications)
- Mapbox/Leaflet for maps
- PWA configuration
